v.title: Motson’s Digital Return: EA’s AI‑Generated Voice Revives Classic Commentary
v.excerpt: EA Sports brings back John Motson via AI for FIFA 27, adding nostalgic commentary to the game.
v.body:
## Quick take
EA Sports has just dropped an AI‑generated John Motson into FIFA 27, launching 26 November. The iconic commentator’s voice is resurrected via deep‑learning, with the blessing of his son and wife.

## What happened
EA Sports announced that the new FIFA 27 release will feature an AI‑generated John Motson. The synthetic voice, created using advanced neural‑network models, will provide commentary during matches. The company secured legal clearance by obtaining consent from Motson’s son and wife, ensuring the likeness and voice are used respectfully.

The move follows a broader trend of sports titles incorporating lifelike audio and visual elements. Fans can now hear Motson’s trademark phrasing and emotional highs, adding nostalgia to the virtual experience. EA’s press release highlighted the technical breakthrough, noting that the AI can adapt to on‑field action in real time.

## Why it matters
- **For Barcelona fans**: Motson’s commentary has historically covered La Liga and Champions League fixtures, including many of Barça’s triumphs. His return, even digitally, offers a richer narrative layer to our club’s moments in the game, letting us relive the excitement of past victories with a familiar voice.
- **For the player’s legacy**: By recreating Motson’s voice, EA preserves a revered figure in football broadcasting. It signals a shift toward honoring legacy while pushing technological boundaries, setting a precedent for future collaborations with other sports legends.
- **For the season’s narrative**: The AI‑generated John Motson adds depth to FIFA 27’s storytelling, mirroring how Barça’s own season is a blend of history and innovation. Fans will experience a bridge between the past glories and the current squad’s aspirations.

## What's next
Watch how the AI‑generated John Motson reacts to Barça’s key moments in FIFA 27. Pay attention to his commentary during high‑pressure situations like the La Liga title decider or a Champions League knockout tie. Notice whether the synthetic voice captures the emotional nuance of real commentary, or if there are glitches that break immersion. This will be a litmus test for EA’s future use of AI voices across sports titles.

*Source: [EA adds AI-generated John Motson to FC 27 video game](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c65y10j841jpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
